questions.prompt: What does `[CmdletBinding()]` do when placed above a PowerShell function definition?

options.a: Promotes it to an advanced function, adding common parameters (-Verbose, -ErrorAction, etc.) and $PSCmdlet
options.b: Compiles the function to a C# DLL
options.c: Restricts execution to Administrator users only

options.a: The caller must supply that parameter (PowerShell prompts if missing)
options.b: The parameter value must be a positive integer
options.c: The parameter must be passed via pipeline only

questions.prompt: Why do advanced function decorators matter during script security triage?

options.a: Malware frequently mimics advanced function scaffolding to appear legitimate; decorators are not a safety guarantee
options.b: Decorators cryptographically sign the script to prevent tampering
options.c: Decorators disable all logging for that function
